## Background

We ran Alphafold2 from [colabfold](https://colab.research.google.com/github/sokrypton/ColabFold/blob/main/AlphaFold2.ipynb). 

We will 

1. Read all model AF2 files

2. Calculate RMSD between all models

3. Calculate RMSF between all residues of all models

4. Examine AF2 scores pLDDT and PAE

5. Calculate residue conservation scores for all residues

## HIV-Pr Monomer

We get a zip archive file from colabfold that I have moved ans uniped in the project directory.

### 1. Input all models

```{r}
model_dir <- "hivp_monomer_94b5b/"

list.files(model_dir)
```

```{r}
pdb_files <- list.files(model_dir,
                        pattern=".pdb",
                        full.names = T)
```


```{r}
library(bio3d)
pdbs <- pdbaln(pdb_files, fit=T, exefile="msa")
```

### 2. RMSD

```{r}
rd <- rmsd(pdbs)

library(pheatmap)

colnames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)
rownames(rd) <- paste0("m",1:5)

pheatmap(rd)
```

### 3. RMSF per residue

```{r}
rf <- rmsf(pdbs$xyz)

plot(rf, type="h")
```


```{r}
plot(pdbs$b[1,], typ="l")
points(pdbs$b[2,], typ="l", col="pink")
points(pdbs$b[3,], typ="l", col="magenta")
points(pdbs$b[4,], typ="l", col="purple")
points(pdbs$b[5,], typ="l", col="red")
```

> We want the consercation to be in the high peak bits. This is plotting b-factor collomn. The higher the b-factor, the more confident we are about the model.

### 5. Residue conservation scores

```{r}
list.files(model_dir, pattern=".a3m", full.names=T)
```

```{r}
aln_file <- list.files(model_dir, pattern=".a3m", full.names=T)

aln <- read.fasta(aln_file, to.upper=T)
```


```{r}
s <- conserv(aln)
s

plot(s, typ="h")
```

```{r}
consensus(aln, cutoff = 0.9)$seq
```

```{r}
library(bio3dview)

#view.pdbs(pdbs)
```
